This '''clone navigation officer''' was stationed aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']].
He and [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]], along with a number of other [[Officer/Legends|officers]], tried to land the ''Endurance'' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] after the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was [[Sabotage of the Endurance/Legends|sabotaged]] by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. The [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], along with Ponds and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Kilian]] survived the ''Endurance'' crash on Vanqor. However, he and the others were captured by Fett's band of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] on the planet's surface. Ponds was [[Death/Legends|executed]] by Fett's accomplice [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], but the officer and Kilian were transported to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. There, he and Kilian were rescued by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] as [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] was about to kill them.
